name: fp_arms_crew
convention: eye at the origin looking down -Z, +Y up, +X right; metres; compose/check at 70 deg vertical FOV, 16:9

clips.name: idle
clips.note: hands mostly out of frame, a slight breathing rise

clips.name: walk
clips.note: arm swing just entering the frame bottom, 1.0 s period

clips.name: press
clips.note: right index presses a button ahead (contact 0.30 s)

clips.name: pickup
clips.note: right hand reaches, closes (0.36 s), brings the object up to the hold pose

clips.name: hold
clips.note: holding a small object 30 cm from the eye

clips.name: inspect_turn
clips.note: turns the held object left and right in the fingers and tips it to look along it; starts/ends in hold

clips.name: put_down
clips.note: from hold: sets the object down (released 0.44 s) and withdraws

clips.name: touch_float
clips.note: index finger hesitantly reaches out and taps (contact 0.60 s), then flinches back

clips.name: wheel_turn
clips.note: both hands turning a hatch wheel, alternating strokes; wheel turns +116 deg (CCW seen by Karl) per loop

clips.name: hands_look
clips.note: raises both bare hands into view, turns them over, flexes the fingers; ends near idle

clips.name: helmet_hold
clips.note: both hands hold the helmet at chest height, visor facing the eye, slight tired sway

clips.name: helmet_lift
clips.note: hands to the neck ring, twist 20 deg, lift up past the camera, down into helmet_hold

clips.name: glove_off_L
clips.note: bare left hand inside the suit glove during fp_arms_suit glove_twist_L; flexes once the glove is off (0.92 s)

skeleton.rest_pose: arms straight ahead (-Z), thumbs up, palms facing each other
skeleton.notes: forearm_twist carries the twist component of the hand rotation (sleeve, cuff and wrist ring follow it); all clips key it. If the game poses hand_* itself it must copy the twist about the forearm axis to forearm_twist_*. upper_arm_* may carry small translation keys.

usage.blend: pickup -> hold -> inspect_turn -> hold -> put_down chain without a pop; press / touch_float / hands_look start and end near idle; helmet_lift ends in helmet_hold. Cross-fade 0.12-0.2 s elsewhere.
usage.anchor_grip: anchor_grip_R rides on bone grip_R. In pickup/hold/inspect_turn/put_down it sits at the centre of the held small object (between thumb and fingers): +Z along the fingers (object up), +Y out of the palm (the face of the object that looks at Karl in hold). At rest it sits in the palm.
usage.anchor_helmet: anchor_helmet (child of bone prop_helmet, a child of fp_root): origin = centre of the neck ring, +Y = helmet up, +Z = helmet front. Parent suit_helmet.glb to it with identity transform. At rest and at the start of helmet_lift the helmet is worn (front = view forward); in helmet_hold the visor faces the eye. Outside helmet_lift / helmet_hold hide the helmet.
usage.helmet_lift: 0-0.42 s hands rise to the neck ring, 0.50-0.78 s twist 20 deg, 0.84-1.25 s lift up and forward (hands leave the top of the frame at ~1.2 s, turn the helmet round off-screen), 1.55-2.2 s down into the helmet_hold pose.
usage.glove_off_L: Companion to fp_arms_suit glove_twist_L: the bare left hand follows the same wrist path inside the glove and flexes once the glove is off (show arm_L only, hide arm_R).
